name: branding-two-child-portraits-on-green-and-red-with-gummy-and-hourglass
title: Two colour-block portraits: girl biting a gummy on green, girl with tub and hourglass on red
whatItIs: A split image: at left a close portrait of a girl in green biting a red gummy on a green backdrop; at right a smiling girl in a red polo holding a gummy beside a tub and a red-sand hourglass on a red backdrop.
whatItMeans: Bold and joyful; matching outfits and backdrops make the child part of the palette.
techniques: Match clothing to a flat backdrop.
Split the frame in two colours.

vocabulary.definition: Subject clothing and backdrop in one hue.
An object suggesting an idea like time.
A tight framing on the face.
